SIKA® ANCHOR-300: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Anchor-300, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sika-anchor-300.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Anchor-300 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Anchor-300 is a hard PVC anchor shaft in grey colour combined with Sikaplan® PVC waterproofing membrane flange in yellow colour.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Anchor-300 is used in double-shell tunnel constructions in combination with waterproofing sheet membranes on base of PVC-p to temporary fix the reinforcement of the inner lining to the outer shell, until the secondary concrete or shotcrete lining is cured and self-supporting.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Anchor-300
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: anchor fixation through sheet waterproofing membranes
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Watertightness test (Vacuum testing). -0.2 MPa by Sika Testing System TM 87
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Allows watertight hot air welded seam with Sikaplan® WP membranes
    - Good force transfer through hard PVC shaft
    - Waterproofing line around anchor (no additional sealing elements required)
    - Anchor steel corrosion-protected
    - Quick and simple installation
2.4 Appearance and colour.
    | PVC Membrane | yellow and black |
    | PVC Shaft | grey |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Diameter: Shaft: Inside Thread M16, length 200 mm; Membrane: 300 mm
    - Ambient maximum temperature of liquids: + 35 °C max
2.6 System structure. Ancillary products:
    - Sikaplan® WP 1100 -types
    - Sikaplan® WP 1110 -types
    - Sikaplan® WP 1120 -types
    - Sikaplan® WP 2101 -types
    - Sikaplan® WP 2110 -types
    - Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-Types
    - Sikadur® -31
    - Sika® AnchorFix®-2
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 30 pcs per box
    - Shelf life: 5 years shelf life from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry conditions, protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality. The substrate conditions are as defined for the waterproofing membrane system which is to be combined with the Sika® Anchor-300.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: Membrane: 2.0 mm
4.3 Application method / tools - Installation method. 1. Cut out a small section of the waterproofing system or drill through it directly 2. Drill a hole into the substrate 3. Clean the drill hole with high pressure water jet 4. Clean the drill hole with compressed air 5. Inject Sikadur® -31 or Sika® AnchorFix®-2, or use anchor capsule 6. Install Sika® Anchor-300 7. Weld against Sikaplan® PVC membrane 8. Install steel anchor for temporary fixing of rebar cage
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Sika® is not responsible for the permissible anchor forces or the related loading calculations.
    - Preliminary pull-out tests are mandatory.
    - Installation works must only be carried out by Sika® trained contractors.
    - The membrane is not UV stabilized and cannot be installed on structures permanently exposed to sunlight and weathering.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. Min. +5 °C
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Anchor-300, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sika-anchor-300.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
